models.notes: Lightweight default remote backend for base installs. Uses ACE Music's OpenAI-compatible hosted music API through stdlib HTTP only; requires an API key. This backend does not install or execute local ACE-Step source/runtime code.

Lightweight remote backend for ElevenLabs Music only. It uses stdlib HTTP and calls the official music generation and composition-plan endpoints, not ElevenLabs text-to-speech or voice APIs. It is the second supported remote endpoint; future priority should shift back to local/open-weight engines.

models.preferred_precision: standalone package runtime: fp16 on Apple MPS by default, bf16 on CUDA/XPU where supported, CPU float32 fallback; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed
models.notes: The explicit `acestep-v15` backend uses vendored ACE-Step Transformers model code and package-owned orchestration rather than an external ACE-Step source tree or package. Real 30-second validation on Apple MPS/CPU found repeated static-loop collapse, so this backend is quality-limited and not the local `acestep` route. The experimental standalone 5Hz LM audio-code planner is opt-in because full-cover conditioning from coarse 5Hz code hints can imprint repetitive artifacts. The default turbo DiT does not use CFG, so guidance is treated as unsupported unless a non-turbo DiT is explicitly configured. Short instrumental generations should be judged with the harmonic-diversity and spectrotemporal artifact gates.

models.preferred_precision: official safetensors/pytorch weights; no official 8-bit artifact reviewed, so prefer official 16-bit/float loading where supported
models.notes: Small 300M text-to-music baseline with a simple Transformers path. Non-commercial weights, so it is a validation/comparison provider rather than a production default. AbstractMusic provides an optional backend through the musicgen extra.

models.notes: Small 341M gated text-to-audio model optimized for short clips and Arm CPUs. Likely useful for sound effects and short loops; model card cautions that music generation can be poor quality. AbstractMusic provides an optional backend through the stable-audio extra, but model loading requires Hugging Face access approval.

models.preferred_precision: AbstractMusic-owned internal runtime; float32 on CPU/MPS, float16 only on CUDA
models.notes: Stable Audio 3 Small Music open-weight gated checkpoint. AbstractMusic owns the inference runtime under abstractmusic.vendor.stable_audio3_min and uses Hugging Face weights/configs only; it does not import the upstream stable_audio_3 package or a local source checkout. Focused 30-second and 120-second local smokes passed objective gates at 16 steps. Initial scope is text-to-music only, with LoRA, inpainting, continuation, audio-to-audio, CoreML/TensorRT, broader prompt/seed validation, and GPU validation deferred.

models.preferred_precision: official Diffusers checkpoint dtype; prefer MPS bfloat16 when available, MPS float32 otherwise, and CPU float32 as final fallback because fp16 can overflow the transformer residual stream
models.notes: Local `acestep` route. Uses Diffusers AceStepPipeline with Hugging Face checkpoint files, not an external ACE-Step source tree or package. On Apple MPS, fp16 can overflow during transformer denoising; AbstractMusic prefers MPS bfloat16 when supported, then MPS float32, and only falls back to CPU float32 if MPS still fails. A 30-second CPU seed-123 smoke passed harmonic-diversity and spectrotemporal artifact gates against the accepted reference floor.
